title: Nutritious French Pomegranate Crepe
description: An earthy and silky French crepe dish featuring pomegranate and pitah bread, perfect for a solo dinner or as a light meal.
instructions: Soak the pita bread in orange juice for at least an hour.
Combine eggs, sugar, and flour in a bowl. Mix well until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add enough oil to lightly coat the bottom of the pan.
Dip each piece of soaked pita into the egg mixture, letting any excess drip off.
Cook crepe for about 30 seconds on each side or until golden brown.
Serve with fresh pomegranate seeds and a drizzle of olive oil if desired.
